title.narrative: Coordinated multi-sectoral assistance to bringing prioritized collective sites up to minimum standards in central and eastern regions.

description.narrative: ltpgtRokada is a CCCM, Protection and Shelter partner, who currently has established presence in 11 number of oblasts with experienced and trained staff. This project aims to bring prioritized 63 collective sites, hosting 6750 number of IDPs, up to minimum standards as per Resolution 930 'On collective site functioning’ and support the vulnerable groups of the site population through CCCM, Protection (including Child Protection), Shelter, WASH, and Education interventions. The sites were selected in line with the list of recommended sites and in coordination with the CCCM Cluster in 6 oblasts across the country (Kirovograd, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv, Dnipro and Zhytomyr regions). Additionally, Rokada will support responsible site consolidation and closure through training sessions for authorities, service providers, site managers, and residents. Community outreach workers will conduct information sessions on consolidation, humanitarian exit strategies, and longer-term solutions.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtGiven the unstable situation in Zhytomyr and Kherson regions, where most of the sites are not legalized due to the lack of partners from CCCM. Rokada is ready to improve these processes in consultation with the clusters and be flexible in prioritizing collective accommodation sites.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtProject will include activities related to supporting CS management and to develop and adopt rules of stay conclude individual agreements for stay between CS management and IDP households to ensure security of tenure, and promote self-governance through the establishment of IDPs councils at the site level. IDP profiling at the household level will identify risks, vulnerabilities, opportunities, and intentions of residents. Social workers will develop medium- and long-term programs based on profiling results.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtProtection component will include activities related to psychosocial support. Psychologists and social workers will mitigate risks associated with site consolidation for IDPs. Mental health and psychosocial support will be provided for children and caregivers through.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtRokada will conduct sensitization sessions to change men's perceptions of masculinity contributing to violence and organize activities for the 16 Days of Activism Against GBV. The project will also support informational lectures, safety audits in collective sites and safe confidential referrals. lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtChild Protection will include monitoring, support, and referrals to specialized services. Capacity building efforts in child protection aim to enhance the skills and knowledge of community-level child protection actors.Community-based mechanisms will be strengthened to prevent and mitigate child protection risks.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtShelter component will include activities Refurbishment of CSs for temporary accommodation of IDPs Rokada has experience in reconstructing communal property into social housing, and will conduct a legal, economic and technical assessment of collective sites that can perform this function. lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtWASH component will include activities related to construction and repairs of water supply or drainage/sewage systems, construction and repairs of sanitation facilities and WASH NFI distributions (laundry equipment, boilers, and cleaning supplies).lt/pgtltpgtEducation component will include activities are envisaged in accordance with the first and second goals. Rokada will apply an integrated approach to service delivery to ensure gender-sensitive and inclusive access to safe (online and offline) learning environments. In particular, Rokada plans to establish TLSs/DLCs to support access to safe learning and socialization (Dnipro, Kharkiv region).ltbrgtAll project activities were designed taking into consideration the specific needs of vulnerable groups, including women, children, older people, and people with disabilities to ensure the centrality of the protection. Rokada will work with OPDs who will be involved in the implementation of the project.lt/pgt
